chunks: Muhammad ibn Hammam ibn Suhayl narrated to me from Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Malik Al-Fazari, who said: Muhammad ibn Hamdan Al-Madaini narrated to us from Ziyad Al-Qandi, who said: Abul Hasan Musa (peace be upon him) said:
I love for you that which I love for myself and I hate for you that which I hate for myself. Complete the prayer in the two Harams, in Kufah, and next to the grave of Al-Husayn (peace be upon him).
ai.seo_question: What did Imam Musa al-Kadhim (a.s.) recommend regarding prayer at the grave of Imam Husayn (a.s.)?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Kamil al-Ziyarat* highlights the spiritual intimacy between the Imams and their companions through the concept of *ittifaq* (shared preference), linking personal devotion to specific sacred sites. It underscores the unique status of the grave of Imam Al-Husayn (a.s.) as a locus of worship, equating its merit with the two major sanctuaries (Mecca and Medina) and Kufah, thereby validating the Shia practice of *ziyarat* as an act of full prayer (*salat al-tamam*).

en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 6. Muḥammad ibn Hammām ibn Suhayl narrated to me from Ja’far ibn Muḥammad ibn Mālik Al-Fazāri, from Muḥammad ibn Ḥamdān Al-Madā`ini, from Ziyād Al-Qandi, who said: Abul Ḥasan Mūsā (Imam Kāżim (a.s.)) said to me, “

I love for you that which I love for myself and I hate for you that which I hate for myself. Establish prayers in full form in the two Ḥarams, in (the Mosque of) Kūfah, and next to the grave of Ḥusain (a.s.).”
